name: Jane
summary: Practice management for allied health clinics such as physiotherapy, chiropractic, massage and counselling: online booking through a branded site, charting templates, intake forms, 1:1 and group telehealth, reminders, invoicing and integrated payments, with an AI scribe and insurance billing as add-ons.
best_for: Allied health practices (physio, chiropractic, massage, counselling and similar) with a handful of practitioners who want online booking, charting, telehealth, reminders and payments in one system, and value unlimited human support and a free data import over the lowest monthly price
skip_if: you want to try the software yourself before paying, because there is no free trial; or you run a large team of part-time practitioners, because every bookable person adds a monthly fee; or you need direct insurer integrations outside Canada, because the ones Jane names are Canadian
honest_knock:
Work out your price from your practitioner count, not from the plan headline. Practice at $79 covers one full-time practitioner; every other person who takes bookings adds $35 a month, or $17.50 if they book fewer than 24 hours a week. A clinic with three full-time practitioners pays $79 + 2 x $35 = $149 a month on Practice, and $99 + 2 x $40 = $179 on Thrive. Front-desk staff without bookable hours are free, which is generous, but a part-timer who creeps past 24 booked hours a week moves to the full-time rate.

The $59 Balance plan is for one practitioner seeing fewer than 20 clients a month. The limit counts invoices, so it is reached quickly, and it is also the plan Jane suggests you drop to if you leave and still need access to your records.

Insurance billing is an account-wide add-on, not a per-person one: $20 a month plus $5 for every extra full-time practitioner, whether or not they bill insurance, and in the US you still need your own Claim.MD clearinghouse account. There is no free trial: you get a demo call, or a shared demo account whose login the vendor hands out weekly through its community or support team.

Check the region. Jane is a Canadian company and several things on its Canadian page, such as Jane Payroll and direct insurance billing with Canadian insurers, are not on the US page, while UK prices are much lower than US ones. We have not used Jane; this review is based on the vendor's pricing page and FAQ in three regions.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-01 on jane.app/pricing with the US locale; the same page shows CAD to Canadian visitors and much lower GBP prices to UK visitors) Three plans, billed monthly. Balance is $59 a month for a single practitioner profile and is capped at 20 appointments a month (counted as invoices, so a class with several attendees uses one per attendee invoice). Practice is $79 a month with one full-time practitioner included, unlimited appointments and staff profiles, free unlimited SMS reminders where SMS is available, and timesheets; each extra practitioner costs $35 a month full-time (24 or more booked hours a week) or $17.50 part-time. Thrive is $99 a month with the same one practitioner included, adds rooms and equipment, availability tagging, in-person self check-in, an automated waitlist, return-visit reminders, packages and memberships, and ratings and reviews; extra practitioners cost $40 full-time or $20 part-time. Admin and support staff without bookable hours are free on every plan. Add-ons: AI Scribe $15 a month per opted-in practitioner for unlimited notes (5 free notes a month otherwise); Group Telehealth $15 a month per opted-in practitioner; Insurance Billing on Practice and Thrive at $20 a month plus $5 per additional full-time and $2.50 per part-time practitioner, applied to the whole account, with the Claim.MD clearinghouse account not included; Jane Websites $59 a month per clinic. US card processing through Jane Payments is 2.85% + $0.25 online and 2.6% + $0.10 in person. There is no free trial; the vendor offers a demo, a shared demo account and a free data import and onboarding call. In the UK the same plans are listed at GBP 29, 44 and 55 a month.

compare_with.name: a booking app plus separate notes
compare_with.why: Many solo practitioners start with a general booking app and keep notes and intake forms elsewhere. That works until clinical records, consent and payments live in three places. What Jane adds is that the charting templates, intake forms, outcome surveys, treatment plans, 1:1 telehealth and invoicing sit in one account with HIPAA, PIPEDA and GDPR compliance claimed by the vendor. For one practitioner under 20 appointments a month the $59 Balance plan covers that; above that the comparison is really Practice at $79 against whatever your current tools cost together, plus the time of keeping them in sync. We have not compared Jane hands-on with other practice-management systems.
